verdict.rationale: Xero publishes an official JavaScript SDK (xero-node) under its XeroAPI GitHub organization. Its developer portal lists SDKs alongside its APIs, and it generates its SDKs from official OpenAPI descriptions, so building against official SDKs is directly supported. Missing for 10: SDKs for languages beyond Node are only implied by the plural 'SDKs' rather than named, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The xero-node SDK makes it easy for developers to access Xero's APIs in their JavaScript code, and build robust applications and software using small business & general ledger accounting data.
This includes Xero APIs, SDKs, code samples, documentation and more.
We are using OpenAPI generator along with these OAS yaml files to generate our new SDKs.
This repository holds the official Xero OpenAPI descriptions
